title: On the Complexity of Finding Stationary Points in Stochastic $(L_0, L_1)$-Smooth Nonconvex Optimization
summary: We study the stochastic first-order oracle (SFO) complexity of finding $ε$-stationary points of $(L_0,L_1)$-smooth nonconvex functions. Under bounded-variance noise, existing analyses of normalized and clipped stochastic gradient descent (SGD) establish optimal dependence on $ε$ and $L_0$, but the jointly optimal dependence on $L_0$, $L_1$, and $ε$ remains unclear.
